results.snippet:
Nigeria-based payments platform OPAY will become the second Chinese-backed African tech company this year to offer shares in international markets. The company plans to market 16 million American depositary receipts at $19 to $21 each, according to its filing last week with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
